block_row: Connects two independent CRC channels using the same elaboration-selected method and parameters.

frame_row: The generator and checker process separate frames concurrently. Each channel contains one instance of the selected CRC method.

label: u_crc_gen
(m_crc_gen)
blocks.function: Accumulates one frame and returns its finalized CRC using the selected method.

label: u_crc_check
(m_crc_check)
blocks.function: Accumulates a separate frame, compares its finalized CRC with the final-beat reference, and reports pass or fail.

interfaces.name: Generator frame stream
interfaces.active: external -> u_crc_gen; ready returns to external
interfaces.signals: external -> u_crc_gen: i_gen_data, i_gen_keep, i_gen_valid, i_gen_last; u_crc_gen -> external: o_gen_data_ready

interfaces.name: Generator CRC result
interfaces.active: u_crc_gen -> external; ready returns to u_crc_gen
interfaces.signals: u_crc_gen -> external: o_gen_crc, o_gen_crc_valid; external -> u_crc_gen: i_gen_crc_ready

interfaces.name: Checker frame stream and reference CRC
interfaces.active: external -> u_crc_check; ready returns to external
interfaces.signals: external -> u_crc_check: i_check_data, i_check_keep, i_check_valid, i_check_last, i_check_crc; u_crc_check -> external: o_check_data_ready

interfaces.name: Checker pass/fail result
interfaces.active: u_crc_check -> external; ready returns to u_crc_check
interfaces.signals: u_crc_check -> external: o_check_pass, o_check_crc_valid; external -> u_crc_check: i_check_crc_ready

legend_note: The enclosing frame is m_crc_engine. Each child wrapper instantiates one copy of the selected method.
